description: A mod for minecraft that adds the ability to customize the background music in for biomes!

releases.notes:
### Musify!-1.2.4: The No Mixins Update!

In collaboration with JaredBGreat and Shivaxi, Updated both Musify and DoomlikeDungeons to support eachother without the use of mixins.
This means that from this update onwards, Musify no longer needs FermiumBooter as a dependency for DoomlikeDungeons music!
- Patched instance crash when using an older version of RogueLike Dungeons

### Musify! 1.2.2

**ITS FINALLY HERE**

Musify 1.2.2 is a complete rewrite for musify. EVERYTHING is better.
firstly, everything is faster, more responsive and much less resource intensive.

secondly, ive added support for music for roguelike dungeons, doomlike dungeons, and recurrent complex structures.
Also ive rewritten a bunch of other stuff.
The mod is also now only 0.61MB. (instead of 90 >_>)
The mod now supports both mp3 AND ogg files!
Read the readme for all features.

Happy new year everyone!

This new version of Musify! contains a patch for a major bug, where vanilla models changed by other mods were overwritten.
Another new addition is that music now mutes when a jukebox is playing nearby!

- Music now no longer auto-repeats.
- HUGE improvement to combat music aggro counter, however, it still might not detect aggro from mobs sometimes because of Mojangs shitty AI code.
